statement:
The record shows the membership was active and set to renew automatically, but Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation of the cancellation.

I will refuse the charge.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the stated facts — "Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation" — and concludes "I will refuse the charge."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
